title: How to Set Up Salesforce WooCommerce Integration (2026)
summary: Salesforce woocommerce integration connects your store data to your CRM automatically. You can choose the best sync method for your business needs.
body_markdown:
## Managing API limits and data sync errors


Managing API limits and data sync errors requires a proactive strategy to prevent silent failures when WooCommerce order volumes spike. Because Salesforce enforces strict governor limits on inbound requests, you must calculate every synchronization event against the total daily allowance to avoid blocking business-critical updates.


A modern automation architecture addresses this by ensuring that a complex, ten-step data validation flow costs the same to run as a simple two-step sync.


The published pricing page shows Zapier bills roughly one task per action step completed in a run, not a flat credit per run regardless of steps, so check it against Zapier's per-task billing and Make's per-module billing on their own pricing pages.


> A modern automation architecture addresses this by ensuring that a complex, ten-step data validation flow costs the same to run as a simple two-step sync.


This allows builders to add as many error-handling steps as needed without increasing the cost of the integration.


### Handling Salesforce API request quotas


Salesforce enforces a rolling 24-hour limit on API requests. This ensures multi-tenant platform stability.


Exceeding these quotas may cause further API calls to be blocked until usage drops back below the threshold, since Salesforce tracks usage over a rolling window rather than resetting at a fixed time. The specific allowance depends on the license tier and the number of active users, as the total pool scales with the size of the organization.

The base capacity is identical across tiers. However, the Unlimited edition has a five-fold increase in per-user scalability, allowing high-volume retail operations to support more frequent synchronization events.


To stay within these bounds, developers should utilize the Salesforce Bulk API for high-volume data migrations so that thousands of records only consume a single request against the quota.


### Resolving WooCommerce webhook delivery failures


WooCommerce webhooks are the automated messages sent when an order is created. These often fail due to server-side timeouts or incorrect secret key validation, resulting in missing records in the CRM.


If the receiving endpoint doesn't respond with a successful HTTP status code within five seconds, WooCommerce will eventually disable the webhook entirely to protect server resources.


Admins must monitor the Webhook Logs within the WooCommerce Status page to identify 401 Unauthorized errors. These indicate that the shared secret has been rotated and the authentication headers no longer match.


### Formatting currency and date fields for Salesforce compatibility


Data synchronization often breaks because Salesforce requires ISO 8601 format for date fields and specific decimal precision for currency, whereas WooCommerce may output localized strings.


A WooCommerce order date formatted as "DD/MM/YYYY" will be rejected by the Salesforce API, so the integration must transform this into "YYYY-MM-DD" before transmission to ensure the record is accepted.


Similarly, currency values must be passed as raw numbers without symbols. Sending a "$" character into a Salesforce Currency field will trigger a validation error and halt the sync process.
